durability.prepare: Authorize before replay. Bind principal+installation incarnation+operation+RequestId+exact normalized input; conflict on different content. Replay attaches same plan/outcome with no new candidate, work, expiry or lease. Different prepare IDs attach/refuse under one installation-scoped unresolved-operation fence, never create a second replacement. After settlement a separately authorized new request may prepare a new repair.
durability.work_before_plan: Acquire and validate actual common CPU, memory, storage and input/output ResourceAdmissionEnvelope before verification/staging/reservation work. Checked aggregate sizes and held private files/roots/ACL identity, cancellation and cleanup accounting remain node-owned; no public source paths or hidden allocations.
durability.freeze: Node holds actual installation and launcher capabilities plus exact measured candidate artifact, manifest, source, toolchain, verification policy, prior effective installation, source/authority generations, revision, expiry, intent and plan digest. JobFrozenRepairPlan is private untrusted observation data, NOT the capability; issuer code and held OS handles must seal provenance. Plan IDs are lookup only.
durability.submit: Fresh current authorization before replay and irreversible action; exact expected revision, same held plan and installation generation, unchanged measured content/launcher/prior state/policy, live admission and active-work drain. At most one submit per plan even under a new RequestId. Existing replacement path only; no parallel scheduler/launcher. Protected installation approval, when genuinely required, binds exact frozen plan digest/operation/installation/nonce/expiry/generation; OS consent is distinct and stale callbacks deny. No public boolean/digest/reference grants approval. Protected authority and OS consent are independent typed observations and may both be required simultaneously; already_authorized describes protected authority only and says nothing about OS consent. Neither DTO grants either condition.
durability.commit: Atomic durable intent/consumption fence wins against cancellation BEFORE irreversible owned handoff. Fence records intent, not installed success. Cancellation first means no handoff; commit first means cancellation cannot claim cancelled, even on error.
durability.recovery: Crash or lost acknowledgement retains exact operation, candidate, backup, launcher and fence custody as reconciling/outcome_unknown. Protected inspection of exact installed receipt/artifact/source/launcher/backup/current generation resolves observed effects; missing/stale/rollback/contradictory witnesses keep unknown or refuse. Never blind retry, guessed rollback, second worker or automatic success. Ready only after actual installed artifact/health/source/runtime verification; resource holds release only after actual settlement.
durability.public_projection: JobState/phase/effect/candidate/authority/progress are untrusted observations. The node validates consistency before delivery. Explicit failed-before/after-commit and outcome-unknown are distinct; commit_fenced never implies success. Public response emits no private path, secret, traceback or raw capability. Redact diagnostics before persistence/output and respect SafeMessage plus actual runtime safe_error limits.
durability.cancel: jobs.preparations.cancel and existing jobs.cancel must delegate to one operation-owned fence/settlement implementation. New control RequestIds cannot reset prepared expiry, revive terminal state or bypass unresolved recovery. No public generic cancellation executor.
durability.watch: Reuse ordered resource stream semantics and InferenceCursor, bound exact authorized principal/installation/preparation/generation; bounded redacted items, reset on expired cursor, reauthorize every event. Disconnect detaches only. Existing jobs.output.read may carry redacted diagnostic progress after correct scope adapter, never impose its membership prerequisite on local repair.
